plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Brocade switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization/total/free/used, temperature, fan, power supply status, and interface traffic, for ICX/FCX/NetIron, Ruckus ICX, and Foundry/IronWare (enterprise PEN 1991).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the 1-minute average CPU utilization of the Brocade/Foundry/Ruckus ICX device (snAgGblCpuUtil1MinAvg, a scalar GET with instance .0), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the system DRAM utilization of the Brocade/Foundry/Ruckus ICX device (snAgSystemDRAMUtil, a scalar GET with instance .0), falling back to snAgGblDynMemUtil when DRAM is absent, reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized routing/MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity, and can cause instability or failed allocations.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports the total system DRAM of the Brocade/Foundry/Ruckus ICX device in bytes (snAgSystemDRAMTotal, a scalar GET with instance .0).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports the free system DRAM of the Brocade/Foundry/Ruckus ICX device in bytes (snAgSystemDRAMFree, a scalar GET with instance .0).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the used system DRAM of the Brocade/Foundry/Ruckus ICX device in bytes, derived as total minus free.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the chassis temperature of the Brocade/Foundry/Ruckus ICX device (snChasActualTemperature, a scalar GET with instance .0). The raw value is in units of 0.5 degrees Celsius and is multiplied by 0.5 at collection time. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat, and can trigger thermal protection or hardware damage if left unaddressed.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each Brocade/Foundry cooling fan (FOUNDRY-SN-AGENT-MIB snChasFanOperStatus), normalized to the unified convention where 1 means normal and any other value indicates an abnormal/fault state. A non-normal state indicates a cooling fault that can quickly lead to overheating and should be investigated immediately.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each Brocade/Foundry power supply unit (FOUNDRY-SN-AGENT-MIB snChasPwrSupplyOperStatus), normalized to the unified convention where 1 means normal and any other value indicates an abnormal/fault state. A non-normal state signals a power redundancy or hardware fault and must be remediated promptly.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
